Name: One Silo Storage
Author: SorryLate
Description:
[b]One Silo Storage[/b]

it's so annoying to build so many Silo just for Hay, so i decided to make this mod.
this Mod inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2587]More Silo Storage[/url]﻿. But i add more feature to make it better.

[b]11/1/2020 : Android version released ![/b]

[b]Feature :[/b]
[list]
[*]Add capacity Silo to 48000
[*]You will receive notification for how many Hay you have everyday
[*]Now you don't need to build Silo for Hay drop
[*]Right click on Silo while holding Hay will add the Hay to Silo 
[/list]
[b]Configuration :
[/b][list]
[*]siloFarm : change number 1 to the number of Silos you have to fix incorrect max capacity notification. [i]default is : 1[/i]
[*]enableNotification : everytime you wakeup, display your current Hay (Silo) / (Inventory). [i]default is : true[/i]
[*]enableHayDrop : if you don't have Silo, this is will drop Hay for you. [i]default is : true[/i]
[*]hayOnGround : if your inventory full, Hay will drop in the ground instead of disappear. [i]default is : true[/i]
[i]
[/i][/list][b]Instalation :[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install Latest SMAPI 
[*]Download and extract .zip file
[*]Move folder OneSiloStorage to StardewValley/Mods
[/list]
[b]Credit :[/b]
[list]
[*]Credit for Pathoschild for making SMAPI and making his mod open source, so i can learn from there.
[*]Credit for OrneryWalrus because of him, i have idea to make mod like him
[*]Credit for all Stardew Valley Modder too
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Fix 48000 capacity in notification, it's weird if you have 2 Silo that's have max capacity 96000 but notification still say your max capacity is 48000. You can change "siloFarm" to the number of Silos you have in your farm to fix incorrect notification.
